text: in cart/editor when you select multiple faces to merge on an outliner, it merges the faces but retains all the previous edges which breaks a lot of the purpose of merging the faces together in the first place

events.text: Root cause confirmed in the host-native face merge: selected triangle groups are relabeled into one authored face, but the welded topology cache is left alive, so its pre-merge boundary classification keeps every dissolved seam visible/selectable. Fixing group-only topology invalidation and adding a Zig regression that proves the shared seam disappears while the outer boundary remains.

resolution: Fixed face merge at the host topology boundary: after selected authored groups fuse, the editor now invalidates its welded-edge cache so shared seams are rebuilt as internal, no longer drawn or edge-selectable. Added a focused Zig regression proving the seam count drops while render triangulation and the outer boundary remain intact, and kept the existing mesh-edit suite under the unit-test target.
